product_overview: Whatomate is a multi-tenant WhatsApp customer service platform that provides real-time chat, contact management, campaign tools, chatbot automation and analytics across Meta and Whatsmeow providers. It centralizes agent workflows, RBAC, integrations (webhooks/API keys) and localization for operations teams.
core_goals: Allow agents to send and receive WhatsApp messages in real time across multiple WhatsApp provider instances.
Provide centralized contacts, templates, canned responses and campaign management to scale outreach and customer support.
Enable chatbot automation via keyword rules and visual flow builder with smooth handoffs to human agents.
Expose integrations and developer tooling via API keys and webhooks while enforcing role-based access control.
Deliver operational insights via a customizable analytics dashboard.
Support multi-organization workflows, theme and language preferences, and per-instance health visibility.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Sign in and register using email/password or supported SSO providers; maintain a verified session and return to the dashboard after authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard at /
Navigate to /login -> Click SSO provider to start external auth -> Complete external provider flow -> Return to /auth/sso/callback -> See dashboard at /
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in incorrect password -> Submit login form -> See error message on invalid credentials and remain on /login
Navigate to /register -> Fill in registration details -> Submit registration form -> See registration confirmation or be redirected to /login on success

features.name: Dashboard Analytics
features.description: Customizable analytics dashboard that surfaces charts and metrics, with controls to add, configure and rearrange widgets and filter reporting periods.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View analytics widgets -> Filter data by date range -> See charts update to reflect selection
Navigate to / -> Click to add new widget -> Configure widget settings -> Save widget -> See new widget appear on the dashboard
Navigate to / -> Drag and drop widgets to rearrange layout -> See widget positions persist for the session
Navigate to / -> Apply a date filter with no available data -> See empty state or 'no data' message for affected widgets

features.name: Chat Workspace
features.description: Real-time chat workspace for agents to view conversation lists, open conversations, compose messages (text/media), use canned responses and manage conversation lifecycle.
user_flows: Navigate to /chat -> View conversation list in sidebar -> Select conversation to view messages (/chat/:contactId) -> Type message in input field -> Send text message -> See message appear in conversation
Navigate to /chat -> Select conversation (/chat/:contactId) -> Send media attachment -> See media upload complete and message appear in conversation
Navigate to /chat/:contactId -> Type message -> Send text message -> API rejects send due to instance policy -> See send error notification and message not delivered
Navigate to /chat -> Select conversation -> Use canned responses to insert reply -> Send text message -> See canned response sent and message logged in conversation

features.name: Contact Management
features.description: Create, read, update and delete contacts; search, tag and assign contacts to agents and export contact lists for external use.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/contacts -> View contacts list with pagination -> Search contacts by name/phone -> See filtered results
Navigate to /settings/contacts -> Create new contact -> Fill contact details -> Save contact -> See new contact listed
Navigate to /settings/contacts -> Edit contact details -> Save changes -> See updated contact in list
Navigate to /settings/contacts -> Create new contact with invalid phone -> Attempt to save -> See validation error and contact not created

features.name: Campaign Management
features.description: Create and run bulk messaging campaigns using templates and recipient lists; monitor campaign progress, pause or cancel runs and retry failed messages.
user_flows: Navigate to /campaigns -> View campaigns list -> Create new campaign -> Upload recipient list -> Start campaign -> See campaign statistics update
Navigate to /campaigns -> Create campaign -> Start campaign while instance is disconnected -> See campaign start fail and receive error explaining instance health
Navigate to /campaigns -> Open running campaign -> Pause campaign -> See campaign status change to paused
Navigate to /campaigns -> Inspect failed messages -> Retry failed messages -> See retry attempts recorded

features.name: Templates Management
features.description: Manage reusable message templates for WhatsApp (Meta provider) or create message drafts for other providers; templates can be created, edited and previewed.
user_flows: Navigate to /templates -> View templates list -> Create new template -> Fill template fields -> Save template -> See template appear in list
Navigate to /templates -> Edit existing template -> Save changes -> See updated template preview
Navigate to /templates -> Create template missing required fields -> Attempt to save -> See validation errors and template not saved

features.name: WhatsApp Flows (WhatsApp Flows)
features.description: Manage WhatsApp message flows (non-visual flows) to orchestrate multi-step outbound or inbound messaging sequences and templates.
user_flows: Navigate to /flows -> View flows list -> Create new flow -> Configure steps -> Save flow -> See new flow in the list
Navigate to /flows -> Edit existing flow -> Update step configuration -> Save -> See changes reflected in the flow list
Navigate to /flows -> Attempt to save flow with invalid branching -> See validation error and flow not saved

features.name: Chatbot Keywords
features.description: Configure simple keyword-based auto-reply rules that trigger predefined replies when incoming messages match configured patterns.
user_flows: Navigate to /chatbot/keywords -> View keyword rules list -> Create new keyword rule -> Set response and activate rule -> Save -> See rule listed
Navigate to /chatbot/keywords -> Toggle rule active status -> See rule become active or inactive
Navigate to /chatbot/keywords -> Create new rule without keywords -> Attempt to save -> See validation error and rule not created

features.name: Chatbot Flow Builder
features.description: Visual builder for designing multi-step chatbot conversation flows using nodes and edges, with the ability to configure node properties and test simulations.
user_flows: Navigate to /chatbot/flows/new -> Drag and drop flow nodes -> Connect nodes with edges -> Configure node properties -> Save flow -> See flow saved and listed
Navigate to /chatbot/flows/new -> Build flow -> Test flow simulation -> See simulated messages and branch outcomes
Navigate to /chatbot/flows/new -> Attempt to save flow with disconnected nodes -> See validation error preventing save

features.name: Agent Transfers
features.description: Manage handoffs from chatbot to human agents: view pending transfers, pick and assign transfers to agents and resume transferred conversations.
user_flows: Navigate to /chatbot/transfers -> View transfer queue -> Pick next transfer -> Assign transfer to agent -> Resume transfer conversation -> See transfer assigned and conversation open
Navigate to /chatbot/transfers -> Pick next transfer when none are available -> See empty queue message
Navigate to /chatbot/transfers -> Attempt to assign transfer to agent without required instance access -> See permission error and assignment prevented

features.name: Canned Responses
features.description: Create and manage pre-defined quick replies with shortcuts to speed agent responses during conversations.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/canned-responses -> View canned responses list -> Create new canned response -> Set shortcut code -> Save -> See new canned response listed
Navigate to /settings/canned-responses -> Use canned response in chat -> Insert canned text into composer -> Send message -> See message sent with canned content
Navigate to /settings/canned-responses -> Create canned response with duplicate shortcut -> Attempt to save -> See validation error and save prevented

features.name: WhatsApp Instances
features.description: Manage WhatsApp provider instances (e.g., Whatsmeow QR instances): create instances, connect via QR code, monitor health and disconnect when required.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/instances -> View instances list -> Create new instance -> Request instance QR -> Scan QR code with device -> Confirm connection -> See instance health status update to connected
Navigate to /settings/instances -> Disconnect instance -> See instance health status update to disconnected
Navigate to /settings/instances -> Scan invalid/expired QR code -> See connection error and instance remains disconnected

features.name: Webhooks
features.description: Configure outgoing webhooks to notify external systems of events; create webhook endpoints, select triggering events and test deliveries.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/webhooks -> View webhooks list -> Create new webhook -> Configure events to trigger -> Save webhook -> See new webhook listed
Navigate to /settings/webhooks -> Test webhook endpoint -> See test delivery success or failure report
Navigate to /settings/webhooks -> Test webhook endpoint returning error -> See failure report and retry option

features.name: API Keys
features.description: Manage API keys for programmatic access: create, copy, set expiration and revoke keys used by integrations and sidecars.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/api-keys -> View API keys list -> Create new API key -> Copy API key -> Store for integration -> See new key listed
Navigate to /settings/api-keys -> Revoke API key -> See key removed or marked revoked
Navigate to /settings/api-keys -> Attempt to copy expired key -> See warning that key is expired and must be recreated

features.name: User Management
features.description: Create and manage user accounts, assign roles and send restrictions, deactivate or delete users and manage user-level settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/users -> View users list -> Create new user -> Assign role to user -> Save -> See new user listed with assigned role
Navigate to /settings/users -> Edit user details -> Save changes -> See updated user information
Navigate to /settings/users -> Create user with an email already in use -> Attempt to save -> See validation error and user not created

features.name: Roles and Permissions
features.description: Define roles and granular permissions, edit permission matrices and set defaults to control access across the application.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/roles -> View roles list -> Create new role -> Edit role permissions matrix -> Save -> See role available for assignment
Navigate to /settings/roles -> Edit existing role -> Update permission matrix -> Save -> See permission changes take effect for assigned users
Navigate to /settings/roles -> Attempt to delete a built-in/system role -> See error preventing deletion

features.name: Team Management
features.description: Create teams, add/remove members and set assignment strategies (round robin, load balanced) to automate distribution of contacts and transfers.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/teams -> View teams list -> Create new team -> Add team members -> Set assignment strategy -> Save -> See team reflected in list
Navigate to /settings/teams -> Edit team members -> Remove a member -> Save -> See team updated
Navigate to /settings/teams -> Set invalid assignment strategy value -> Attempt to save -> See validation error

features.name: Theme Switching
features.description: Toggle application appearance between dark and light modes with immediate visual feedback and persisted preference.
user_flows: Start application -> Click theme toggle button -> View theme change immediately
Change theme -> Reload application -> See previously selected theme applied
Click theme toggle button while storage is unavailable -> See visual theme change for session but preference not persisted after reload

features.name: Language Switching
features.description: Switch the UI language (including RTL support where applicable) so users can operate the product in their preferred locale.
user_flows: Start application -> Click language selector -> Select language from dropdown -> View UI language change immediately
Select a language -> Reload application -> See selected language persist across sessions
Select unsupported locale -> See fallback to default locale and a notification indicating the selection is not supported

features.name: Organization Switching
features.description: Switch the current organization context for multi-tenant users to access data and settings for different organizations they belong to.
user_flows: Start application -> Click organization selector -> Select organization from dropdown -> View context change to selected organization
Switch organization -> See data and settings update to reflect the chosen organization
Select an organization the user no longer belongs to -> See permission error and remain in current organization
